name: Ki2
description: Electronic shifting integration for Karoo. View battery, gear ratios, and control screens via hood buttons.
long_description: Ki2 is a companion app for electronic shifting groupsets produced by a Japanese company. It allows seamless integration with Karoo screens, low battery notifications, and synchro shift alerts.

name: Vin-HkE
description: Training and planning extension based on Vin's CORE. Includes workout player and pace partner.
long_description: Vin HkE is an extension implementation for Hammerhead Karroo based on Vin's CORE and the new Hammerhead SDK for its GPS devices. Tested in Hammerhead K2 and K3 devices.

name: K-Power
description: Estimates your wattage based on resistance, wind, and FTP. Virtual power meter.
long_description: Adds a virtual power meter device that estimates your wattage based on rolling resistance, FTP, headwind, drag coefficient and more.

name: K-Remote
description: Control Karoo via ANT+ remotes. Swipe screens and trigger actions remotely.
long_description: KRemote allows to use a remote with Karoo and perform some actions with it (swipe screens, etc. depending on current view).

name: K-DoubleType
description: Show two data types (e.g. HR and Power) in a single data field.
long_description: This extension for Karoo allows to use custom fields with double types in the same field (HR in right, Power in left, etc).

name: K-Actions
description: Automate webhooks and messages (SMS/Whatsapp) on activity triggers.
long_description: KActions allows to execute webhooks and send automated messages when you start or stop your activity in a Karoo GPS.

name: Karoo Reminder
description: Advanced hydration/nutrition alerts based on custom triggers and intervals.
long_description: Shows in-ride alerts based on custom triggers. Reminders can be set to activate after specific time, distance, or sensor range.

name: PowerBar
description: Display a colored overlay power/HR bar at the edge of the screen.
long_description: Shows an overlay power bar at the edge of the screen. Created as a replacement for the LED bars on Wahoo computers.

name: Headwind
description: Wind direction and speed field with hourly weather forecasts.
long_description: Adds a visual data field showing the wind direction and speed relative to your riding path, plus hourly weather forecast from open-meteo.

name: TileHunting
description: Overlay for StatsHunters tiles. Real-time alert for unexplored tiles.
long_description: Adds a map overlay that shows explored tiles and an alert if you ride into an unexplored one. Connects to StatsHunters.com.

name: SpinTunes
description: Full Spotify media control for Karoo. Playlists, thumbnails, and volume.
long_description: Karoo datafield with media controls for Spotify. Includes offline mode if Spotify is sideloaded on your Karoo.

name: K-Pedal
description: Real-time pedaling efficiency: Balance, Torque Effectiveness, Smoothness.
long_description: Displays Balance, Torque Effectiveness, and Pedal Smoothness metrics from ANT+ Cycling Dynamics power meter pedals.

name: Wattramp
description: Free offline FTP testing: Ramp, 20-min, and 2x8-min protocols.
long_description: WattRamp lets you perform FTP tests directly on your Karoo with real-time data fields during your ride. No subscriptions required.

name: FlightRadar
description: Track nearby aircraft in real-time. Radar display for Karoo.
long_description: Displays nearby aircraft using open-source flight data APIs. Supports North-Up and Track-Up orientation modes.

name: K-Radar
description: Customize radar alerts with custom beeps and notification styles.
long_description: Hammerhead Karoo extension which allows to configure radar alerts, replacing default sounds with custom beeps.

name: RouteGraph
description: Alternative elevation profile with POIs, climbs, and HERE traffic data.
long_description: Adds an alternative route elevation profile data field that includes POIs, climbs, and traffic incident reporting via HERE maps.

name: Waypoints
description: POI search (online/offline) and navigate. Search cafes/shops via SIM.
long_description: Waypoints is the extension app improving the navigation convenience: POI online search & offline storage, click-to-navigate.

name: Notepad
description: Minimalistic datafield for your custom text/reminders.
long_description: Provides a datafield you can put your own text on. Open from menu to input text.

name: W' Balance
description: Anaerobic capacity tracking (Skiba method). Time to exhaust.
long_description: Karoo datafield displaying metrics related to W' Balance. Optimized for real-time computation.

name: W+ Prime
description: Enhanced W' tracking with six algorithms and real-time computation.
long_description: Track your anaerobic capacity in real-time. Six scientific algorithms to fit your training style.

name: ColorSpeed
description: Speed display with zone-colored background and targets.
long_description: A Hammerhead Karoo extension to display speed with a colored background and target icons.

name: CupRoute
description: Curated coffee shop finder (Europe). Offline database & navigation.
long_description: Offline, curated specialty coffee shop finder for cyclists. Browse shops and open in Karoo navigation.

name: eiRadar
description: Smart radar alerts with distance thresholds and night mode.
long_description: Smart rear radar extension providing sound, vibration, and visual alerts with smart cooldowns.

name: 7climb
description: Climbing assistant: W' balance, terrain insights, and power targets.
long_description: Help riders make better decisions on climbs through real-time pacing and terrain insights.

name: WattSpeed
description: Virtual speed based on power during indoor trainer sessions.
long_description: Provides a virtual speedometer that calculates speed from power independently of flywheel speed.

name: K-Breathe
description: Live breathing metrics and Vitalpro sensor integration.
long_description: Hammerhead Karoo application for Tymewear Vitalpro Breathing sensor. Records metrics to FIT files.

name: NomRide
description: Track carb balance, hydration, and nutrition reminders in real-time.
long_description: Track carb balance, burn rate, and hydration — all directly on your Karoo screen with FIT sync.

name: MetricsOverlay
description: Stream live ride metrics to OBS as a browser overlay.
long_description: Streams live ride metrics over WiFi as a browser overlay for OBS live streaming.

name: Barberfish
description: 3-column HUD with zone coloring and premium aesthetics.
long_description: Native-feeling data field enhancements for Karoo. Three-column HUD showing speed, HR, and power.

name: WaxWatch
description: Dynamic chain wax life tracking based on weight and surface.
long_description: Track your chain wax life across multiple profiles. Adjusts based on rider weight and surface type.

name: VeloVigil
description: HRV computation, crash detection, and AI coaching integration.
long_description: Data-sovereign cycling intelligence with Polar H10 HRV and crash detection. Telemetry syncs to Cloudflare.

name: Zone Graph
description: Graphical data fields showing recent history of HR and Power zones.
long_description: Graphical data fields showing zone-colored curve history of HR and power. Cycle windows: 1m, 5m, full ride.
